name: Ukraine
summary: Russia's full-scale invasion continues, with active frontlines in the east and south and continued long-range strikes on both sides.

name: Gaza / Israel
summary: Israel-Hamas war with periods of ceasefire and renewed operations; humanitarian crisis ongoing in Gaza.

name: Sudan
summary: Civil war between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), with one of the world's largest displacement crises.

name: Yemen
summary: Houthi forces continue Red Sea shipping attacks and hold northern territory against the internationally recognized government and coalition-backed forces.

name: Red Sea / Bab el-Mandeb
summary: Houthi missile and drone attacks on commercial and naval vessels have disrupted a major global shipping corridor.

name: Strait of Hormuz
summary: Key oil-transit chokepoint between Iran and the Arabian Peninsula; a persistent flashpoint tied to Iran-related tensions.

name: Iran
summary: Ongoing tension with Israel and the US over Iran's nuclear program and regional proxy network.

name: Lebanon
summary: Israel-Hezbollah cross-border conflict with periods of intense strikes and fragile ceasefire arrangements.

name: Syria
summary: Continued instability and sporadic violence following the fall of the Assad government, with multiple armed factions still active.

name: Taiwan Strait
summary: Persistent Chinese military pressure around Taiwan, including air and naval incursions near the median line.

name: South China Sea
summary: Overlapping territorial claims and repeated confrontations between China and neighboring states over disputed reefs and shoals.

name: Korean Peninsula
summary: North Korean missile testing and rhetoric continue against a backdrop of a formally unresolved war with the South.

name: Sahel (Mali/Niger/Burkina Faso)
summary: Jihadist insurgencies and military-junta rule across the Sahel, with Russian Wagner/Africa Corps involvement replacing Western forces.

name: Eastern DR Congo
summary: M23 rebel offensive and a complex multi-armed-group conflict in the eastern provinces, with regional troop involvement.

name: Myanmar
summary: Civil war between the ruling military junta and a coalition of ethnic armed organizations and resistance forces.

name: Somalia
summary: Long-running al-Shabaab insurgency against the federal government, with African Union and international counterterrorism support.

name: Afghanistan
summary: Taliban rule since 2021 with a collapsed economy, ISIS-K attacks, and unresolved humanitarian and governance crises.

name: Bosporus Strait
summary: Turkey-controlled strait linking the Black Sea to the Mediterranean; a key artery for Russian and Ukrainian grain/energy shipping under the Montreux Convention.

name: Suez Canal
summary: Critical global shipping shortcut between the Mediterranean and Red Sea; traffic has already been depressed by Houthi attacks further south.
